description: Example manifest for a 3-page blog guide batch plus coordinator-owned hub/sitemap integration.

compliancePolicy.rule: Zero tolerance site-wide for the forbidden word families listed in data/route-factory/compliance-words.json (forbiddenWords). Run scripts/audit-compliance-words.mjs per route; 0 blockers required before merge (TX Insurance Code §4102.163 / Devin Herpin compliance fence).
compliancePolicy.insuranceLanguage: Topic-conditional. Only routes with insuranceRelevant:true may reference the claims process, and should soft-link to /services/insurance-claims/ rather than repeat compliance jargon (AEO concentration-over-repetition). Mechanical/maintenance routes (ventilation, decking, gutters, etc.) get NO compliance block.

notes: Workers should remove or replace example routes before using this manifest.
Coordinator owns sharedFiles. Worker-only batches should leave sharedFiles empty.

Set insuranceRelevant:true only on claim-context routes (default false). Do NOT reintroduce old claim-handling compliance-boilerplate requiredPhrases — that pattern caused the 2026-05-24 forbidden-word + saturation incident.
